content:
The overhauled Workshop UI now makes it easier to find items to build, while relaxed building rules in Adventure Mode give everyone more freedom to build the C.A.M.P. to create their dreams.

At the same time, the project to overhaul the fighting that began last year is nearing its end. Enjoy increased melee weapon damage, enhanced damage over time effects, improved manual aiming, and changes to the V.A.T.S. make it even more reliable.

There's a lot to discuss, so let's get to it!

### Update highlights

- Loose building rules – let your creativity run wild! Thanks to the relaxed building rules, you can now create new types of C.A.M.P.s.
- Overhauled Workshop user interface – To make it easier for you to find your C.A.M.P. items in the future, we have overhauled the Workshop user interface.
- Item Locking – This widely requested new feature makes accidental scrapping a thing of the past.
- Fights – We have the V.A.T.S. and improved manual aiming and increased damage and range in various ways.
- Season 22: Trendy Home – Modern wastelands need a modern home.

### Update version 1.7.21.25 and download sizes

- **PC (Steam):** 9.9GB
- **PC (Microsoft Store)** : 23Gb
- **Xbox** : 26.4GB
- **PlayStation** : 25.6GB

### Relaxed building rules

Anyone who likes to build C.A.M.P.s in Fallout Worlds already knows the advantages of the relaxed building rules.

At this point, let's dedicate ourselves to some general aspects of these loose building rules and the new possibilities they offer you!

**Snapping Items**

You can still snap items like you used to, but this is no longer the case for items that required it.

If you want to have wallpaper on both sides, you can now have your walls overlap each other.

You can now build walls below the ground. You can also now attach upper floors to walls without stairs.

**Toggle placement modes**

There are three placement modes to choose from in your C.A.M.P. Items to place:

- Snap Mode (Normal) – Places items in the usual way.
- Collision mode – objects do not snap into place automatically but can collide.
- Free Mode – There is no snapping or collisions.

**Placement Restrictions**

While some items still have to stay on the ground, such as plants, extractors or items with or near water, this restriction no longer applies to others, so you can now place them freely. Yes, even in the air.

**Foundations**

Unlike before, some items no longer require a foundation. And if you remove an item, your den will still remain accessible.

**Power cable**

You can now place these even if they overlap with another object!

**Blueprints**

There are no changes here in relation to the new building rules. You can implement blueprints while objects are floating, overlaying others, or unsupported.

### Workshop 2.0

This update brings with it a completely revamped Workshop menu! We've now organized the interface in a way that should make it much easier for you to find everything you need. We have tested this internally and are excited to present it to you.

#### New main and subcategories

What you'll immediately notice next to the new user interface is the combined main and subcategories for all of your workshop items. If you're organized like this, you should now be able to find what you're looking for much more quickly.

The categories are:

-Quests
- Objectives (This category only appears when there is an active quest and disappears again after it is completed.)
- Recently
- This is how you can quickly find recently used items.
- History
- New
- Recently
- Blue
